attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Started After Backup Protection Disabled
attributes.description: Detects backup protection disablement followed by restore or recovery activity for the same resource within 60 minutes.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects backup protection disablement followed by restore or recovery activity for the same resource within 60 minutes.

attributes.query:
sequence by druva.resource.name with maxspan=60m
  [ any where druva.event_type like~ ("*Backup*Disabled*", "*Backup*Paused*", "*Backup*Suspended*") ]
  [ any where druva.event_type like~ ("*Recover*", "*Restore*") ]
